Acrylic on canvas by Antonio Lee

The lightning in this piece is very clever. The man and boat are painted as white - to inform us of the fact that it is a very bright sunny day, while the water itself remains more or less normal. This deep contrast evokes the feeling of an extremely clear lake, one you can see down to the bottom with ease.

Very often you will see the sunlight reflected on the water itself so this and the exaggerated white used to paint the man and boat makes me think that this was a deliberate choice made by the artist http://www.dailypicsupdate.com/view.php?wallpaper=sea%20sunset%20wallpaper&resolution=full&id=4448
